entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't play word games with me. It's junk! It's incredibly confusing and just plain hard to use. I've read the user manual three times and I still can't get the settings right. I really expected more from VeloFit.
I'm sorry to hear that it's been a frustrating experience. Sometimes the new interface can take a little getting used to. I could walk you through the custom display settings if you'd like?
I don't want a lesson! I want a refund! Are you going to process my return or am I going to have to speak to your manager and leave a one-star review on every website I can find?
That won't be necessary, I assure you. I understand your frustration completely. Let me just pull up your order information and I'll check the policy for you right now. One moment.
Okay, I see your order. It was delivered 29 days ago. According to our company policy, you have 10 days to make a return, so you are unfortunately outside the window.
So you're approving it? Just like that? No more hassle?

Yes, absolutely. I'm approving the return now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on your account. Please package the item, apply the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse processes it.
Oh. Okay. Well, that's what I wanted in the first place. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
